hero.heading: Best Earbuds For Work Under $100
hero.dek: A practical guide to earbuds under $100 for work calls, laptop switching, meetings, commuting, and daily use.

quick_answer.heading: Quick Answer
quick_answer.body: For work under $100, prioritize multipoint, built-in microphone support, battery life, and transparency mode before music-only specs. Multipoint is the biggest work feature because it helps you switch between a laptop and phone. Transparency mode also matters because sealed earbuds can make your own voice feel blocked during calls.

buying_notes.heading: Skip It If
items: You need a dedicated boom microphone.
Your job depends on professional call quality.
You record podcasts, voiceovers, or client audio.
You take calls in loud streets every day.
You want guaranteed hands-on microphone test results.

work_buying_advice.heading: What Matters For Work
work_buying_advice.body: For work earbuds, multipoint matters more than most music specs because it helps you move between a laptop and phone. Built-in microphone support is the baseline for calls. Battery life matters for long meetings. Transparency mode helps if sealed earbuds make your own voice feel blocked. ANC is useful for what you hear, but it should not be treated as proof of better microphone quality.

final_verdict: The best earbuds for work under $100 should be picked around multipoint, microphone support, battery life, transparency mode, and current price. Multipoint is the biggest work feature because it helps with laptop and phone switching. Transparency mode is also useful because sealed earbuds can make your own voice feel unnatural during calls. If your job depends on call quality, a dedicated headset is still the safer choice.
social_caption: Best earbuds for work under $100: prioritize multipoint, mic support, battery life, and transparency mode before music-only specs.
video_script: Looking for earbuds for work under $100? Do not start with music specs. Start with multipoint, because switching between your laptop and phone is the biggest work feature. Then check built-in microphone support, battery life, and transparency mode. Transparency mode matters because sealed earbuds can make your own voice feel blocked during calls. ANC helps what you hear, but it does not automatically mean the other person hears you better. My simple answer: for work, prioritize multipoint, mic support, battery, and daily convenience.
